items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Paul's playing abilities and mentions him in the context of Jimmie Lunceford's band ('before [Paul] ... before Dan Grissom'), but does not explicitly state a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct professional relationship with Paul himself.

ctx.x: And he really made a name for himself because, gee whiz, Paul --
